title: Gremlins 3
overview: The third installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

title: Star Wars: Starfighter
overview: An original story set approximately five years after the events of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker.

title: The Nightingale
overview: The lives of two French sisters are torn apart by the onset of World War II.

title: Plátano Champion
overview: A summary of the Dominican Republic's undefeated championship run in the 2013 World Baseball Classic.

title: Tafers Code
overview: Tafers Code follows five teenagers at the T.A.F. language school in Itaquaquecetuba, guided by the charismatic Teacher Gilmar. Each episode explores the unique challenges and strengths of the students as they discover how learning English can transform their lives. With humor, emotion, and a touch of documentary style, the series culminates in a final project that inspires not only the characters but everyone to take the first step toward a brighter future through language learning.

title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
original_title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
overview: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

title: UK Holiday
overview: A UK Holiday is not just a journey; it’s an adventure filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. The story revolves around Aakash, a kind-hearted and adventurous young man, who invites his sister Rekha from the USA to visit the UK for a long-awaited family reunion. Rekha, excited to escape her routine, is thrilled to meet their mother, Subhadra, and sisters Priyanka and Deepika, who already reside in the UK. Aakash ensures this holiday becomes a truly special experience. Together, they explore London’s iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge. The journey takes them to the natural wonder of Durdle Door in Dorset and the charming town of Aldershot. Along the way, they share stories, laughter, and moments of deep connection. This feature film captures the essence of holidays—taking a break, reconnecting with loved ones, and creating memories that last a lifetime. UK Holiday is a celebration of family, adventure, and the joy of togetherness.

title: Malvina
overview: Malvina is an angel sent to earth for being ignorant of it's problems. she falls to earth and after an incounter with a grieving mother seeks adamentley the love she talks about. when receiving this love finally she becomes addicted. she is filled with so much love for everyone she eventually loses herself completely in the desires and wants of everyone around her.

title: Being Heumann
overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

title: Everest: The Other Side
overview: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.

title: Dolioo
overview: Sarah Jamson, daughter of Hudson’s murdered ally, wages a one-woman war against Hudson, using stealth, strategy, and vengeance-marked corpses to haunt him psychologically. Chloe Varenne, a symbol of lost love and innocence, becomes the spark that pushes KAEL toward rebellion.

title: Bunker Heights
overview: Citizens of a troubled city must navigate through an unforeseen crisis that threatens every walk of life.

title: Every Time I See A Cock I Go Funny
original_title: Every Time I See A Cock I Go Funny
overview: When a Yorkshire coal miner's trousers get stolen, a scandal erupts that sinks the colliery into turmoil, exposing the hypocritical, horny heart of postwar British pride and masculinity.

title: Trevor Lies
overview: The bizarre tale of a young boy and his puritan family who must grapple with the morality and consequences of deceit

title: Loser Lesbian Vampire
overview: Carmilla is a vampire with a hopeless crush on Laura, an effortlessly cool writing major. To cope, Carmilla throws herself into toxic distractions: hooking up with a Mormon closeted lesbian whose blood tastes like repression, and murdering men (even though she finds masculine blood absolutely revolting.) Torn between hunger and heartbreak, Carmilla's unlife is spiraling. But obsession, like immortality, is hard to kill.

title: The Fall of Barsisa
overview: A modern re-imagining of the fable of the same name. Three brothers leave their ailing sister in the company of a devout and honourable figure as they are guided by an ambiguous stranger through treacherous terrain in search of a remedy.

title: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
original_title: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
overview: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

title: Night Terrors
overview: Don’t wake a sleep walker...

title: BARI
overview: Seeking to bring the dead back to life, Bari ventures into the underworld in pursuit of a life-giving flower. Yet her journey is driven not by heroic sacrifice, but by an escalating and uncontrollable obsession. She enters an eerie realm where life and death coexist on a horizontal plane, and as her desire consumes her, she is forced to confront the impossibility of fulfilling it. Trapped in an endless cycle of longing and loss, Bari can do nothing but repeat her journey.

title: Fireflies
overview: In the blue hour between day and night, a quiet neighborhood is visited by fireflies and ghostly lights.

title: Midnight Drop
overview: It’s November 8th, 2004—and Halo 2 drops at midnight, a night that will go down in gaming history. Best friends Adam and Tone are gearing up for an unforgettable all-nighter, but their plans go off the rails when two suburban punks hold up their local GameStop. What was supposed to be an epic night of gaming quickly turns into a chaotic hostage standoff.

title: Fuck Mr Flanagan
overview: A journey into the woods causes two stoners to question their friendship and purpose in life - while they try to avoid a devious figure named Mr Flanagan.

title: Art of Destruction
overview: We follow the story of The Thinker bombing at the Cleveland Museum of Art, trying to solve the mystery behind it because no one was ever caught. By following this case, we unravel the whole landscape of Cleveland and the USA in the 60s/70s - student protests, social justice movements, anti-war movements, and radical militant groups. We give a context to the bombing, which is symbolic on so many levels - it's an art piece that randomly became a target for political violence that, by being left unrepaired, became a reminder of the complicated history of the 60s/70s. The Thinker is a silent witness to this fascinating decade, looking down from his pedestal, still thinking about our place in the world as humans.

title: Whiplash '89
overview: A tedious day in film school is interrupted by a psychic escape into the glorious excess of a 1989 Metallica concert. Part classroom satire, part headbanger fantasy, Whiplash '89 transforms film-school boredom into a no-budget act of cinematic rebellion.

title: Wild
overview: Wild is a survival dramedy set in the breath-taking yet unforgiving Scottish Highlands. Lou, Dev, and Alistair, three old friends clinging to their annual wild camping tradition, begin with banter, nostalgia, and amateur vlogging, but soon unravel into a battle of egos, secrets, and survival when they get lost, food runs short, and friendships fracture. At once funny, poignant, and unsettling, "Wild" explores the line between adventure and recklessness, and how toxic masculinity has become a huge part of the epidemic decline in men’s mental health.

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
original_title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
overview: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

title: The Love Hypothesis
overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

title: Isolation
overview: Isolation explores loneliness, grief, loss, and the struggles of mental health. All within a pursuit of understanding one's purpose. It's a coalescence of one's trauma and working through it while performing at a high level.

title: One Last Shot
overview: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

title: Misfit Mentor
overview: This slice-of-life documentary follows a New Jersey-based elementary school teacher who spent his nights playing in a successful punk/ska band with his first ever music student. Now, many years later, after suffering a family tragedy, he's finally retiring as an educator in hopes of taking a third bite of the apple.

title: Antonio's Road
overview: It's 1929. Antonio immigrates from Italy to become a success as an artist in America. Mary leaves Ireland to make a better life for her child. Their paths cross again and again as their dreams are crushed. It will take the next generation to make it in America.

title: Murder, She Toked
overview: Best buds Hannah and Mel investigate a mysterious murder at the anniversary party of a Hip-Hop mogul's weed lounge.

title: Aurora Ave: Sunrise to Sunset
overview: This documentary captures Seattle’s infamous Aurora Avenue from morning to night.

title: The Depths
overview: After a brother and sister achieve astral projection, the footage they capture reveals the malicious effects of their family trauma.

title: Cursed Waters
overview: Shipwrecked pirates fleeing the Navy wash ashore on a remote island, only to discover it's home to a bloodthirsty cult guarding secrets no one was meant to find. Now survival means escaping both the law and something far worse.

title: Godmother
overview: A meticulously planned desert couples' vacation spirals into chaos when family tensions and a pair of mysterious hosts with devilish intentions transform a romantic getaway into a nightmare.

title: That Photo In My Wallet
overview: A lonely teenage girl struggles to navigates an overwhelming sense of isolation that alienates the people closest to her.

title: The Duffel Bag
overview: A man named Polly, who successfully stole a duffel bag on a dangerous final job, looks to pay everything back that he owes, but Honey, whom he reports to, wants something more he didn’t sign up for.

title: Into the Betaverse
overview: Gary's just proposed to his girlfriend. However, their relationship only exists in a virtual world – the Betaverse. Technophobe best mate, Dave, suspects she's a scammer, so he begrudgingly enters the Betaverse to spy on them.

title: We Set the House on Fire
original_title: We Set the House on Fire
overview: Five strangers happen upon a mysterious house on New Years Eve, their secrets and connections begin to be uncovered as the night takes a supernatural turn.

title: Mina Hartong: Miss Personality
overview: Known for her razor-sharp wit and heartfelt storytelling, award-winning comedian Mina Hartong mines her personal life- her Connecticut upbringing, life as a lesbian, and years as a public school teacher- to deliver a comedy special that is as hilarious as it is healing.

title: Buddies
overview: Over a weekend of skiing, 14-year-old Aiden navigates the boundaries of his friendship with Lucas.

title: Bloodline
overview: Set against the systemic oppression of Chinese American communities, this elegant, spine-chilling drama follows two siblings in 1952 Utah as they search for their family's hidden treasure.

title: Sunburn
overview: When a citywide blackout knocks out the power on one of the hottest days on record, a group of neighborhood kids set out in search of relief, unaware that the day will quietly mark the end of their childhood.

title: Aineolach
overview: When a grieving gay minister relocates to a remote Hebridean village to preach, he's met with a few frosty smiles and silent judgement. But as the island's first Pride begins to bloom in secret, he must choose between blending in or standing up — risking his peace, his purpose, and maybe even his heart.

title: His Best Man
overview: Two lovers reunite after years apart, only for one to be engaged and ready to move on and engaged to a new man. He asks his old lover to be his best man and bless his new union. His best Man is a gay South-Asian romantic musical comedy, but less Bollywood and more Indian-Western fusion music.

title: The Phone Booth
overview: A man is anxiously waiting for a pay phone to ring, while a dark presence is observing close-by.

title: The Joker of Freetown
overview: A musician named Joker gives a tour of his home: the Copenhagen anarchist community known as Freetown Christiania.

title: [the who-baba oreilly]
overview: People wait for the intro of Baba O'Riley by The Who to end so they can sing the song at karaoke.

title: Turtle Island Rap
overview: Follows three aspiring Indigenous hip-hop artists on their challenging journey to success.

title: The Last Photograph
overview: An ex-DEA operative must return to the mountains of South America in an effort to find his missing niece and nephew, following the brutal murders of their diplomat parents. Enlisting the help of a washed-up junkie war photographer, the only person to have seen the face of the killers, he sets out, determined to find the children and the truth, but soon learns he must also face the ghosts of his past.

title: Patient Number 10
overview: After losing his friend in a car accident, 16-year-old Adam visits a psychiatrist, unaware that he himself died in the same accident. As reality begins to unravel, the doctor discovers he has lived through this encounter ten times.

title: Vintage Violence
overview: When a disgraced livestreamer discovers a trove of rare vintage denim in a Colorado mine, he follows it to Tokyo and straight into the arms of a woman who may be using him. Caught between desire and betrayal, he soon finds himself entangled in black-market turf wars, yakuza, and a past that refuses to stay buried.

title: Meat Daddy
overview: Rick is nervous to meet his girlfriend Kristy's Dad for the first time. They just got engaged and he wants him to approve. But when they get to her Dad's small cattle property it's immediately obvious that things are awry - in fact Rick has just entered some kind of surreal nightmare world. Calling Kristy's Dad strange is an understatement, Kristy is acting just as bizarre, there's a creepy small boy next door in a cabaret mask, a dead tree with unsettling aura, and when Rick tries to escape he physically can't. When the weekend reaches its untimely end we then switch perspectives and see things from Kristy's Dad's point of view. Which is incredibly more bizarre.

title: STOMACH BOOK: The Caput Mortuum Tour Documentary
original_title: STOMACH BOOK: The Caput Mortuum Tour Documentary
overview: A home video style documentary following a band of trans women as they tour westward across the United States and Canada.

title: Disney Channel Mitmachkino (2026) September
overview: Does going to the movies mean lights out, quiet, and sitting still? Not at the Disney Channel Interactive Cinema! Here, children can sing along, dance, clap, and solve riddles for an entire hour – anything but being quiet! On the big screen, Mickey Mouse, as the animated host of the 2026 Cinema Festival, guides moviegoers through the colorful program, designed for the youngest viewers of preschool age, offering approximately 65 minutes of child-friendly, interactive cinema. Tickets are only €5!

title: Still Night, Burning House
overview: In her deeply personal debut feature, award-winning filmmaker Carol Nguyen charts her family’s first reunion since her uncle’s mysterious death. Travelling together to Vietnam, the family embarks on a revelatory—and at times uncanny—journey through intergenerational trauma and many-layered loss. With care and probing curiosity, Nguyen guides her loved ones as they navigate unsealed medical records and a decades-long silence, ultimately leading them back to each other. A metaphysical poem for complex mourning, Still Night, Burning House shows how storytelling can transform grief into collective healing.

title: CONTACT
overview: CONTACT is a short documentary film directed by Jonathan Walley that chronicles the transformation of an entire skatepark into a playable musical instrument—where the skate, BMX, art, and music scenes collide.  HCS has been many things: a skatepark, gallery, library, museum, and stage; but, for one weekend, Derek Nelson fabricator,  activist, BMX pro, and artist, transformed his skatepark into an immersive sonic installation—part instrument, part playground—for the community of Binghamton, NY to become co‑creators in a conflagration of sound. SMALL TOWN, BIG SOUND.  CONTACT reminds us of the joy in creativity, community, and the DIY spirit. Contact is about pushing boundaries, experimenting with art, and reclaiming space in an increasingly cruel, unkind, and oppressive world. It’s a poetic exploration of the creative process told by a filmmaker who calls HCS home.

title: Malevolent
overview: A construction worker, arrives at a house he is assigned to demolish, only to have the place reopen the shadows of his past.

title: Gail
overview: A superfan of the Canadian band Our Lady Peace follows them on their 30th anniversary tour across Canada.

title: Dr Who Meets the Scorpion
overview: Whilst investigating her brother's disapperance, Jennie meets the eccentric Dr Who and all that follows.

title: YOU DON'T KNOW HOW LUCKY YOU ARE
original_title: YOU DON'T KNOW HOW LUCKY YOU ARE
overview: A 16mm experiment in double exposure and harsh noise, ruminating on feelings of isolation, overwhelment, and perseverance.

title: Purgatory
overview: In the early 1980s, 13-year-old Beatrice Gravel's comfortable world—family, school, and church—fractures when her mother moves out to 'self actualize', leaving Beatrice and her younger sister Chloe with their devastated father. As Beatrice doubles down on a plan to 'fix' her family, she barrels through bullies, friendship blowups, a make-out party, and a kleptomaniac babysitter—forcing her to decide who she wants to be when she can’t get what she wants.

title: Whatcha Want
overview: When a young trophy wife and recent immigrant from Hong Kong uncovers her wealthy husband's betrayal, she reignites her passion for dance, forcing her to choose between the life she was given and the liberation she longs for.

title: Lemonade
overview: Danny, a kind-hearted teen about to age out of the care system is facing adulthood without family or support. After a turbulent childhood and separation from his younger brother, Danny is determined to build a future - but one reckless mistake puts him at risk of prison. As his 18th birthday approaches, Josh - his former social worker and the only adult who ever believed in him - returns, offering guidance when Danny needs it most. With new love, big dreams, and overwhelming challenges, Danny must choose whether to repeat the cycle of his past or fight for the life he deserves.

title: Ancestors
overview: 1988.  Dreams, memories and history collide as a young man searches for his missing friend.

title: This Time, I Mean It
overview: This Time, I Mean It, is a Comedy Drama that follows the story of Sam, who must fight against time to stop his girlfriend from leaving his life forever.

title: Faith
overview: Gina, a hard-working and devoted single mother, meets a quietly enigmatic stranger, Michael. The presence of someone who appears to care for her brings a new and exciting dynamic to her life, despite the fact she knows nothing about him or what his intentions towards her really are. Is he a friend, a potential lover or something more sinister?

title: Daughters of 9/11
overview: Twenty-five years after the deadliest terrorist attack on American soil, Elizabeth Miller, Jessica Trant and FBI special agent Frank Pellegrino confront whether the man accused of masterminding the attacks, Khalid Sheikh Mohammed (KSM), will ever face justice.

title: The Face of Horror
overview: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. When Edward’s treachery culminates in a tragedy that robs Eleanor first of her beauty and then of her life, she returns as a ghost to eke bloody revenge on Edward and his new bride.

title: Last Seen in Crimea
overview: Crimea, Ukraine's southernmost peninsula, was once known for its idyllic nature, warm climate, resorts, and rich Crimean Tatar culture. Since its illegal annexation in 2014, Russia has turned it into a modern-day Gulag where thousands of Ukrainian civilians are held in secret prisons in which Russian special services refine their skills of oppression. Through firsthand accounts from survivors, leaked databases, and months of OSINT work, the film uncovers the network of FSB-run detention sites and names the officials responsible for running them.

title: Drive Through Fire
overview: The story follows an addict war veteran turned rideshare driver who helps a terrified passenger escape a human trafficking ring serving wealthy clients.

title: Black Forest
overview: Jack and Alice find a video camera while hiking in the woods. As he reviews the footage, Jack’s sanity is pushed to the limits as the people he watches calls out to him looking for his soul.

title: Between Late April and Early May
original_title: Between Late April and Early May
overview: A docu-fiction film that captures the oddities and absurdities of human behaviour during the annual cherry blossom bloom in High Park, Toronto.

title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
original_title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
overview: A seventy year old widow recovers from a stroke in the care of his dysfunctional family. While his body is failing him, his libido still rages on – unwittingly sparked by the attentions of his daughter-in-law, a dancer with a shady past.

title: Mindflip
overview: Marilyn Hardesty is an aging horror film actress, and heiress to her ancient husband's biotech fortune through a whirlwind courtship, marriage, and funeral. Terminally ill, she is determined to cheat death and rekindle her career by transferring her mind into the body of a younger woman. With Norman Baetz, her "personal assistant", she recruits Dr. Laurence Fine, a brilliant, twisted neurobiologist, to serve her obsession with immortality. With the promise of Reality TV stardom, they lure three young women to Marilyn's remote estate. Ulterior motives unfold. Early experiments prowl the estate. The young women reach a grim realization: escape is the only means of survival. Can they evade Dr. Fine's cut and paste cybernetics? Will Marilyn achieve eternal life or drown in the fountain of youth?

title: Trash Mountain
overview: A twenty something gay man travels from Chicago to his home in rural Missouri following the death of his father — an obsessive hoarder who has left a house full of items, some valuable and some not so, to pick through.

title: With Love, Beatriz
overview: Following Beatriz’s death, her granddaughter Alice embarks on a journey through memories of her grandmother’s youth, a time shaped by the Brazilian civil-military dictatorship. During the 1970s, while still in high school, Beatriz witnessed those close to her disappear amidst the prevailing regime's authoritarianism. In these trying times, she confronts her deepest fears and emotions, realizing the need to remain resilient and fight for her ideals. Friendships, loss, self-discovery, and resistance permeate this coming-of-age story.

title: Ain't No Sunshine
overview: It all started with a girl, the rat king who took her, and three outlaws who are going to try to get her back. In the wild western wasteland, there's gonna be hell to pay.

title: Pussy Gets Bit!
overview: In an underground drag-wrestling scene, Pussy The Insane Clown, a flamboyant T-boy performer, faces off against their ex, CatRatBat, a feral and enigmatic wrestler. Still grappling with unresolved feelings, their rivalry spills into the ring, blending punk theatrics with raw emotional tension. With the sharp-tongued Red Hot Rhonda hyping up the crowd, the match becomes a wild spectacle of love, pain, and performance.

title: MEMORY STICK (HOW TO PREPARE NEW YEARS)
original_title: MEMORY STICK (HOW TO PREPARE NEW YEARS)
overview: In the final days before New Year’s Eve in Denmark, a long-distance couple tries to fix a broken tape camera they need to capture the fireworks at midnight. Shot across multiple formats, the experimental video diary follows their race to repair it while clinging to the little time they have together in person, fearing it will slip away as quickly as the images they’re trying to save.

title: Ratrace
overview: What would you do if you found a bag full of money?

title: The Housewife
overview: A young New York Times journalist tracking down a potential Nazi officer living secretly in Queens.

title: The Sunsets in the West
overview: A folk duo begins to have issues when one of them wants to leave the band and pursue music with their girlfriend instead.

title: The Next Shift
overview: In efforts to try and fit in with his new classmates, Wesley decides to join a couple of them on a night out that leads to a crime that may change the course of his life.

title: The Fix
overview: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

title: The Train
overview: On the final journey of the legendary Majestic Imperator Train de Luxe, Europe’s elite boards for a farewell voyage. Owner Leo Goldberg stages a glamorous on-board show and private auction as the train travels from Vienna to Prague via Budapest, selling the Majestic to the highest bidder. But the train is more than a luxury relic: it is a controlled, mobile platform with secure compartments, limited exits, and near-total anonymity. That makes it irresistible to intelligence agencies. A Russian agent under deep cover, MI6 operatives posing as newlyweds, Chinese agents secretly wiring the train for surveillance, and a former special forces officer traveling with his daughter all converge on board. Behind champagne and polite conversation, a covert war unfolds. As the train speeds through the night, the stakes rise, trust erodes, and escape routes disappear.

title: The Forbidden Wish
overview: When Marie is confronted by her brother, she receives a One Wish Willow and makes a forbidden wish. But when her wish comes true, she discovers that it isn’t the wish she truly wanted.  A fan-made One Wish Willow short film, inspired by the legend of Curry Barker’s Obsession (2026).

title: Mr. Vapey Man
overview: He's packed with juicy flavors. You'll never get enough if you let him give you - just. One. Puff. It's a new era, and no one is afraid of the boogeyman anymore. Unfortunately, something far worse is hiding under the bed.

title: Rain Rain Go Away
overview: Heartbroken after losing an interracial relationship, a young man meets a woman at a Kuala Lumpur bus stop during a rainpour. As they share their stories of love and loss, her uncanny resemblance to his former lover forces him to confront memory, grief, and letting go.

title: We Remember What We Remember
overview: After over a decade since graduating secondary school, the filmmaker gathers old friends to ‘remember’ the collective memory of their school life, ‘revealing’ different perspectives of incidents and ‘resolve’ the lingering trauma of adolescence.

title: Worm Regards
overview: A group of four friends are hired by the mysterious Mr. E to retrieve and deliver to him the remains of the equally mysterious Maurice Thomas Graves, resulting in many strange interactions at his café.

title: Ourselves in the Archives
overview: Ourselves in the Archives is a historical tale featuring a forbidden love story. Eleanore's family is set on her being wed, despite her objections she feels like she has no say. Eleanore runs off to meet Tilly, a maid who she'd much rather spend her days with. But how will history remember her?

title: Sesudah Taiping
overview: Champ, Jay, and Adam visit their old friend, Khidir in Taiping after his mother passes away. Champ noticea an unsettling change: Khidir is entirely consumed by A.I. even to communicate. The trio sets out to find answers.

title: High Ground
overview: In the winter of 1976, a small plane carrying millions of dollars’ worth of marijuana crashed into a remote lake in Yosemite National Park. A group of young climbers from the legendary Camp 4 community then crossed the High Sierra in brutal winter conditions to recover the cargo, concealing and distributing it through a secret operation beneath Yosemite’s cliffs.  Fifty years later, the story has become legend. Climbers, rangers, investigators and the families of the two pilots each carry different versions of what happened, shaped by loyalty, self-preservation and time.  High Ground brings together those voices, many speaking publicly for the first time, to separate fact from folklore and examine how a reckless tragedy became one of climbing’s most enduring myths—and what happens when a community is allowed to write its own history.

title: & Ever
overview: @rgray828 and @Ever_06 meet for the first time.

title: The Cactus
overview: As Trysdale prepared for the year-end international exchange formal with Odessey and Malvous in a quiet afternoon, his thoughts drifted to an exchange student named Hecate when he once again locked eyes with the cactus she gave to him, whose fleeting connection with him had dissolved into quiet regret, or maybe there's still a glimpse of chance?

title: Zero Intention of Living Quietly
overview: Mistreated by people unable to cope with his unique visible difference, actor Adam Pearson glimpses a path away from isolation through his love of cinema. Upon meeting kindred spirit Ellie - a girl who shares his genetic condition, NF1 - their quest begins to forge a new type of movie hero, and finally press play on life.

title: Cassandra
overview: When his support worker Cassandra leaves, autistic musician Seymour embarks on a turbulent journey of independence and self-discovery, forcing him to navigate change, assert his independence, and find his own unique voice.

title: The Cote Photo
overview: To many investigators, this photo has become known as the best official UFO photo ever made public. This image has endured decades of scrutiny and, if anything, has grown more relevant over time. As governments around the world begin to acknowledge and declassify UFO/UAP encounters, the Cote photo feels less like an anomaly and more like an early glimpse into a much larger, still-unfolding story. It continues to fascinate researchers and the public alike—and raises the possibility that more images like it remain hidden, classified, or yet to be released. With Sergio Loaiza as his guide, attorney Esteban Carranza explores how encounters with the unknown transform identity and belief.

title: We Need More S.A.F.E. Spaces for Women!
original_title: We Need More S.A.F.E. Spaces for Women!
overview: In a world where men and monsters seem to be becoming one and the same, Jo recovers Laurie from the site of a monster attack and introduces him to S.A.F.E., an organization working to end the threat of MANkind once and for all.

title: Bleed
overview: A family in crisis on Halloween night is thrown into turmoil when a long-estranged relative shows up on their doorstep after committing a horrific crime.

title: CHAT
overview: A family's fresh start unravels when their son discovers an AI powered tablet, unleashing a wave of terror tied not only to the supernatural but to dark secrets of greed and corruption that surround them.

title: She Saw Us
overview: When four friends discover a cursed two-headed doll in a remote forest, they unleash a vengeful witch who traps them in a place from which no one has ever escaped.

title: Late Night At The Movies
overview: After an Employee goes missing, Kayleigh is called into work on her only day off. She plans on spending the night after hours only to find that something sinister is lurking throughout the Theater - Stalking her.

title: I Constantly Thank God for Esteban
original_title: I Constantly Thank God for Esteban
overview: Home alone on the eve of her First Communion, 12-year-old Carmen receives an unexpected visit from a trio of neighborhood roller girls and scooter boys. While at her home, the kids make Carmen painfully aware of her religious upbringing, ultimately stealing her First Communion dress, culminating in a final showdown at their local roller rink.

title: Tea with Judi Dench featuring Ian McKellen
original_title: Tea with Judi Dench featuring Ian McKellen
overview: Dame Judi Dench is joined by her great friend for tea and a warm, candid conversation about their extraordinary lives both on stage and off. From Shakespeare, stage fright and the insecurities of acting, to the worldwide fame of the Lord of the Rings and James Bond movies, they reflect on success, failure and the importance of never taking either too seriously. Along the way, Ian speaks movingly about coming out, his defining role in the fight against Section 28, and one of his greatest regrets; never sharing the truth about himself with his parents.

title: Hauntshow
overview: The twisted final broadcast of an underground variety show. A mysterious, macabre, deviant and delinquent double-bill of chillers hosted by Hauntrella, Hauntressa and the dearly departed Hauntiana.

title: Post-Shart Clarity
